location.description: The location of the Cloud Run service. If not specified, it may be parsed from the parent resource or provider configuration.
location.rationale: Restricting location ensures IAM policies are applied only in approved regions.

service.description: The Cloud Run service that the IAM policy applies to.
service.rationale: IAM policy should only be applied to approved services to prevent unintended exposure.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
project.rationale: Using approved projects prevents IAM permissions being assigned in incorrect or unauthorised environments.

member/members.description: Identities granted privileges in the IAM role, such as user, serviceAccount, group, domain, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers.
member/members.rationale: Broad member types such as allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers, or domain can expose the service to unintended users.

role.description: The IAM role that is applied to the member or members.
role.rationale: Overly privileged roles can allow privilege escalation or unauthorised changes to Cloud Run services.

policy_data.description: The IAM policy data generated by a google_iam_policy data source.
policy_data.rationale: This field contains the full IAM policy, including members and roles. Misconfiguration can allow public access or excessive permissions.
